name: Prayer Circuit
summary: A mosque is carved into a circular time cycle, with a broad progress sweep around its outer edge.
why: The time-cycle circles share x54,y54. The mosque dome and doorway share x59. The negative minaret and hall connect through a six-unit bridge, leaving one coherent carved mosque silhouette.
risk: The mosque is drawn as negative space. At 24 px the progress sweep is clearer than the fine distinction between tower and hall.
sub1: Architecture formed by generous negative space
sub2: The progress ring follows the same outer contour
theme: A mosque inside the daily cycle
reasonToChoose: You want prayer timing and the mosque fused into a single circular mark.
